approval_gate: Nolan approves every exact post. Silence is not approval.
first_installment_sketch: Seed the ledger with mechanisms already studied: Puck's editor mechanics (ADOPTED in part, canonical state REJECTED per D24), Remotion's deterministic composition mechanics (ADAPTED as a read-only POC). Each row gets PROJECT / COMMIT or VERSION / LICENSE / MECHANISM STUDIED / ADOPT-ADAPT-REJECT / WHY / PING WRAPPER / DEPENDENCY COST / EXIT COST / TEST. Fields not yet verified are marked UNKNOWN, not guessed.
inputs: each OSS mechanism studied: project, commit or version, license
the adopt/adapt/reject verdict with reason, wrapper, dependency cost, exit cost, test
name: PUBLIC HARVEST LEDGER
outputs: per-mechanism verdict entries with exit costs
purpose: Demonstrate that PING harvests commodity OSS mechanics deliberately instead of reinventing infrastructure or dependency-shopping.
template: One row per mechanism: PROJECT / COMMIT-VERSION / LICENSE / MECHANISM STUDIED / ADOPT-ADAPT-REJECT / WHY / PING WRAPPER / DEPENDENCY COST / EXIT COST / TEST. Rejections are published with the same weight as adoptions. The ledger is append-only: later re-verdicts add rows, never rewrite history. Pair each ledger entry with its ADR (D24) where the decision is consequential.
